acceptance: The work package is complete when the frozen-manifest run produces the required artifacts and every contrast/cell is reported as null, negative, inconclusive, research association or non-evaluable. No outcome can enable scoring, ranking, gating, sizing, alerts, portfolio use or trading.

amendment.scope: selection/manifest determinism, HAC definition, seam predicate, rank-statistic nulls and effective-block ordering only

calendar_and_label_contract.endpoint_gate: A row is evaluable only if root and SPY each contain every canonical date from e0 through eh, with native dates exactly equal to that canonical sequence. No row-offset shift, reindex, interpolation, fill, substitute benchmark or price fetch is allowed.
calendar_and_label_contract.era_boundary_purge: Feature t and every label date through eh must lie within its reporting era and eh must be on or before 2025-12-31.
calendar_and_label_contract.feature_date: t is the archive observation date only
calendar_and_label_contract.label_end: eh = h NYSE sessions after e0
calendar_and_label_contract.label_start: e0 = first canonical NYSE session strictly after t
calendar_and_label_contract.price_source: native adjusted close from flow-ops-wt/data/yahoo; never Greek underlying_price
calendar_and_label_contract.split_seam_guard: Call the existing _has_split_seam separately on root native adjusted-price fill_index and SPY native adjusted-price fill_index for each candidate horizon. If either predicate is true, null the row with SPLIT_SEAM_ROOT or SPLIT_SEAM_SPY. This guard is separate from the era-end purge; it does not define an unregistered era seam.
calendar_and_label_contract.volatility_target: annualized standard deviation (ddof=1) of the h log adjusted-close one-session returns whose endpoints span e0 through eh

chain_quality_and_join_contract.exposure_quality: For gamma/vanna/charm, use engine.exposure_math.usable_quote(iv, oi) and dealer_exposures after the additional un-crossed bid/ask, positive strike/spot, right and DTE screens; require at least 90% finite contributing-Greek coverage among usable joined contracts for that root/date/feature. OI and Greek underlying fields are feature inputs, never target prices. The long-call/short-put dealer sign is an explicit model assumption, not measured dealer inventory.
chain_quality_and_join_contract.join: Greeks and OI must each be unique on identity and join one-to-one for the same root/date; duplicate or unmatched identities are excluded and counted.
chain_quality_and_join_contract.missingness: No imputation. Emit feature/date/root reason codes and per-era denominators for absent price, join, quote, Greek coverage, tenor, calendar and support failures.
required_contract_quality: expiration > date (0DTE excluded by this research screen)
finite positive same-session unadjusted Greek median spot
finite underlying fields required by a feature

contrasts.paired_ablation: For return-target features only, report paired same-date/root-set IC(VANNA_RELIEF)-IC(VEX_NORM) descriptively only; it has no separate p-value, BH slot or acceptance gate.

For every return-target feature, report paired same-date/root-set IC(feature)-IC(MOM5_BASELINE) descriptively only; no separate p-value, BH slot or acceptance gate. For GEX's RV target, if a price-momentum RV comparison is reported, it must use MOM5 versus the same RV target on the exact matched root/date set and is likewise descriptive only.

costs_and_unsupported.reason: Daily EOD bid/ask is not an executable entry/exit NBBO path and the archive has no option fills, marks, fees, slippage or assignment lifecycle.

unsupported_matrix.executable_option_pnl_and_costs: unsupported: no entry/exit option marks/fills/cost model
unsupported_matrix.fresh_final_oos: unsupported: selected history was already outcome-exposed
unsupported_matrix.historical_known_at_or_vintage: unsupported: no availability or revision fields
unsupported_matrix.measured_trade_flow_and_trade_sign: unsupported: no attributable trade tape/NBBO-at-trade path
unsupported_matrix.model_training_calibration_or_serving: out of scope and prohibited by this protocol

inference.cell_estimate: mean date-level IC; also report median IC and all coverage denominators
inference.date_level_statistic: For each contrast, era and horizon, calculate scipy.stats.spearmanr across that date's eligible scored roots, using SciPy average ranks for ties. A date needs at least five roots and the exact contrast-specific eligible set. SPY, SPX and SPXW never enter the cross-section. If feature or target is constant on that candidate date/root set, emit CONSTANT_FEATURE or CONSTANT_TARGET and do not count an IC date.
inference.effective_support: For each contrast/era/horizon, sort eligible feature dates ascending. Greedily select the earliest; each selected label interval is inclusive [e0,eh]. Select a later candidate only if its e0 is strictly greater than the previously selected eh, because a shared endpoint overlaps. effective_blocks is the selected count.
inference.interpretation: Era tables are stability disclosure. No pooled survivor is a fresh OOS confirmation because all included history was previously outcome-exposed.

multiplicity.decision: reject only when final monotone BH adjusted p <= alpha; report raw p, rank, adjusted p and reject separately
multiplicity.family: all 10 contrasts x 3 eras x 2 horizons
multiplicity.registration_requirement: This real new 60-test family must be registered in config/ruling_graph.yml meta.known_fdr_families under the current Chairman research grant before analyze mode; an absent or mismatched token refuses the study.

inference.sparse_rule: A cell failing any support threshold is NON_EVALUABLE, receives no raw p or adjusted p, stays visible and retains its predeclared multiplicity slot.
inference.uncertainty: For each cell with n observed IC dates, mean=mean(IC). On the full canonical eligible-session index define u_t=IC_t-mean if IC_t is observed, else u_t=0. With L=max(floor(4*(n/100)^(2/9)),2*h), capped at n-2, calculate Vmean=[sum_t(u_t^2)+2*sum_{l=1..L}(1-l/(L+1))*sum_t(u_t*u_{t-l})]/n^2. Do not divide lag products by observed-pair counts and do not apply a finite-sample factor. If Vmean is non-finite or <=0, emit DEGENERATE_HAC_VARIANCE and mark the cell NON_EVALUABLE. Otherwise use Student t with df=n-1 for the two-sided p-value and 95% HAC confidence interval. Missing sessions remain zero residuals on their original canonical positions and never compress lag distance.

population.duplicate_underlying_rule: SPX and SPXW are coverage-only and never scored, preventing duplicate-underlying observations. SPY is benchmark-only and never appears in a scored cross-section.
population.price_coverage_note: The audited adjusted-price corpus supports 18 of the 20 scored roots historically through 2026-07-16. DIA and ARKK remain visible non-evaluable in every affected cell; no substitute price source is allowed.

primitives.atm_iv: For a requested bucket, select the expiry nearest that bucket target, breaking ties toward the earlier expiry: near uses 15<=DTE<45 target 30; back uses 60<=DTE<120 target 90. At that exact expiry require both a call and put with valid un-crossed quotes and IV, choosing each leg whose absolute delta is nearest 0.50. ATM IV is their arithmetic mean rounded to six decimals, matching the canonical primitive. One-leg ATM is rejected; there is no tenor or leg fallback.
primitives.cw_ivspread: Use the same-session unadjusted Greek median spot for the +/-8% moneyness screen, never adjusted close. At one exact >=7D expiry nearest 30 calendar days (ties earlier expiry), pair call and put at identical strike; require >=3 pairs, each valid/un-crossed, finite IV, abs(call_iv-put_iv)<=0.50 and positive OI. Compute sum((call_iv-put_iv)*(call_OI+put_OI))/sum(call_OI+put_OI), then freeze the canonical primitive's five-decimal rounding. Record weight_kind=oi, n_pairs and tenor_days. No short-tenor, equal-weight, volume-weight or one-leg fallback.
primitives.d5: Every five-session change uses exact canonical date t-5 sessions and requires that root's valid primitive at both endpoints; no five-row surrogate.
primitives.doi5: Aggregate OI growth, not matched-contract flow: sum finite positive OI across same-date valid identities at t divided by the corresponding aggregate at t-5 canonical sessions minus one. At both endpoints enforce the identical identity, right, positive-strike and expiry>date (0DTE-excluded) policy; both aggregate totals must be finite and positive.
primitives.exposure_normalization: net exposure divided by sum of absolute contract exposures of the same Greek; zero denominator is non-evaluable
primitives.mom5: adjusted_close(t) / adjusted_close(t-5 sessions) - 1; both endpoints required.
primitives.skew: At one exact >=7D expiry nearest 30 calendar days (ties earlier expiry), select the put with finite valid delta in [-0.98,-0.02] nearest -0.25 and the call with finite valid delta in [0.02,0.98] nearest +0.50; both legs require valid un-crossed quotes. Skew is put_iv-call_iv rounded to four decimals, matching canonical compute_skew. No moneyness, tenor or leg fallback.
primitives.term_slope: ATM IV at one selected 15-45D expiry minus ATM IV at one selected 60-120D expiry; both legs must satisfy the two-sided ATM rule.

purpose: Fit-free, reproducible retrospective association research using the existing daily Theta EOD/OI/Greeks archive. It is not historical alpha validation.
required_outputs: immutable source manifest and manifest SHA-256
machine-readable all-60-cell result including NON_EVALUABLE cells
coverage and unsupported-feature matrix with reason-coded exclusions
human report stating PIT_UNPROVEN, retrospective association only, no alpha or production authority
reproduction command that refuses a non-identical manifest
95% HAC confidence interval and calendar-aware observed-pair counts for every inferential cell
selected-file availability/vintage-column scan recorded in the frozen manifest

source_snapshot.analyze_mode: Accept only an exact byte-identical manifest hash. Any changed, missing, extra, unreadable or schema-drifted file refuses the study; no refresh, fallback, fetch or partial rerun.
source_snapshot.date_quality_scope: Only source observations dated 2017-01-01 through 2025-12-31 are admitted; rows outside that interval are not candidates.

manifest_contract.content_identity: Only source-relative paths, expected-slot state, selected-file SHA-256, selected-file schema/date/coverage records and frozen study metadata are manifest content. Source roots are resolved from command arguments and absolute host paths are excluded.
manifest_contract.prepare_analyze_rule: Prepare records every expected selected slot before any target/outcome computation. Analyze requires byte-identical canonical manifest content/hash and identical expected-slot states.
manifest_contract.serialization: JSON object keys recursively sorted; lists sorted by their declared stable key (relative_path for file entries); UTF-8; ensure_ascii=true; separators=(",",":"); exactly one terminal newline.
manifest_contract.transport_metadata: Filesystem stat data may be checked for read transport but is never manifest identity or hash input, preserving cross-host portability.

metadata_audit_receipt.consequence: No feature is eligible for a PIT or decision-time availability claim. OI publication day/prior-EOD semantics and all later Greek/OI revisions remain unproven.
metadata_audit_receipt.scope_limit: The 240-file hash/date/schema sample is evidence about that sample only. It does not establish a whole-archive vintage conclusion.

source_snapshot.observation_semantics: as_recorded_EOD(date) only; date, filesystem time and current archive bytes do not establish first-known availability or vendor vintage
source_snapshot.prepare_mode: Before any target, return, IC, p-value, financial value or summary outcome is computed, inventory every selected source file and adjusted-price file with relative path, size, SHA-256, schema columns, min/max date and selected-root coverage; scan the selected-file columns for availability/vintage fields; canonicalize and hash this whole selected-input manifest. The earlier 240-file sample is not a substitute for this whole-selected-file confirmation.

coverage_only_headers.rule: Inventory/header/schema coverage only. Their feature values, labels and returns are never loaded into a scored cross-section.

selection.out_of_scope_files: Files outside these exact selected slots do not alter the manifest and cannot create an extra candidate, root, year, feature or result.

price_source_slots.missing_slots: Every expected benchmark/scored-root price slot is a manifest entry. Its state is present or missing; either state changing between prepare and analyze refuses.

theta_source_slots.missing_slots: Every expected root/year/kind slot is a manifest entry. Its state is present or missing; either state changing between prepare and analyze refuses.

supersedes.reason: independent determinism-review clarification before any real-data or outcome access; the v1 artifact remains preserved and this amendment does not claim that its prior freeze was unmodified
